sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.

2. This is an application for bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s.376/511/506 IPC read with Section 8 of the POCSO Act in connection with Binjharpur P.S. Case No.255 of 2024 corresponding to C.T. Special POCSO Case No.54 of 2024 pending in the court of learned Special Judge, Jajpur.

entities.text: C.T. Special POCSO Case No.54 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 3. It is alleged in the F.I.R. that the Petitioner is the principal accused in the alleged crime.

4. Having regard to the allegations in the F.I.R., there appears material in the case with regard to the offence under the POCSO Act and as such it is not desirable for this Court to grant anticipatory bail without compliance of notice.

However, it is directed that in the event the Petitioners surrender and move for bail // 2 // before the learned court below, the learned court in seisin over the matter shall dispose of the bail application on its own merit being alive of the position of law on bail keeping in view the gravity of the offences taking into consideration the materials on record as well as other documents available on record.
The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
